rationale: The user asked for help splitting payment or, failing that, modifying or canceling the order. The policy requires authenticating the user, acting only on their own orders, confirming any order-changing actions before executing, and escalating to a human if the request cannot be handled. The provided conversation shows no authentication, no tool calls, no confirmation steps, no actionable information about the order or items, and only a generic closing message. There is no evidence of fulfilling any of the user’s requests, nor of appropriate escalation. Therefore, the agent did not complete the request in line with policy.
